holdout_card.fact_statement: The song "Ah! ca ira!" was performed during the Liberté sequence of the 2024 Summer Olympics opening ceremony.
holdout_card.source_span: In one of its windows, a beheaded Marie Antoinette (who was imprisoned at the site before eventually being guillotined) sang the opening notes of Ah! ca ira!, joined by heavy metal band Gojira
